headline: phase_membrane is the thread's real result. From noise, cells whose own link product forms a material ring at the phase wall divide into daughters that each carry a ring (gen 2-3) and re-form the ring after 35-40% cuts: L6[L3]+L4a (medium). The base phase protocell is L6[L2], because its 'membrane' is a contour of phi. The L7 sweeps are mostly contagion between living cells, not selection among lineages.
message_to_researcher:
DECISION: CONTINUE (promise 8/10). Consolidate on phase_membrane and stop spawning variants.

WHAT CONVINCED US
- phase_membrane is your real headline, and you under-claimed it: L6[L3] + L4a (medium).
  - Every cell has an L ring 2.1-2.5x its core.
  - Two judges traced divisions in which both daughters re-form a complete ring.
  - From noise you get 9-12 persistent splits (gen 2-3) in 3 seeds.
  - The ring and gen 3 survive dt/2 and 2x resolution.
  - 35-41% cuts re-ring within about 150 t, against undamaged twins.
- phase_swimdiv: L6[L2] + L4b (medium). It reproduces on new seeds and with an isotropic stencil. First dividing swimmers in the lab, but propulsion is a hand-coded per-body rigid drift.
- phase_protocell_noise: L6[L2] (high), numerically converged. L4a is Weak: a 3/3 heal test, but on one seed.

WHAT DID NOT
1. Base-world L3. 4phi(1-phi) is a contour of phi, and L is a filled disk (wall/core about 1.1).
2. L7 is Weak.
   - phase_kinds sweeps by contagion. On seed 11, divisions breed true, but 45 intact K1 cells turned K2 without dividing, against 8 mutations. With mutation off, K2 still took over. K1 cells never died; K2 cells died 174 times. Your tracks.png #26/#50/#59 shows cells turning pale mid-life. The parasite is most simply an infection.
   - phase_trait: not converged, no neutral control, the trait is invisible, and the population is frozen.
3. phase_protocell does plant phi walls; init() contradicts your claims table.
4. Cite Zwicker 2017 and the stochastic corrector (Szathmary & Demeter 1987).

MAIN EXPERIMENT: who wins when the horizontal channel is closed?
Port K1/K2 (c2=0.3) into phase_membrane (chi=2). Run 3 seeds per arm, each >=32k t:
- A, leaky: as in phase_kinds.
- B, confined: K mobility ~ phi^4, and autocatalysis masked at phi<0.5.
- C, neutral: c2=c1 under B.
- D, parasite: b2=0 under B.
Colour cells by kind in the sheet. With a small labkit-independent overlap tracker, report per seed:
- conversions of intact cells per mutation;
- per-kind birth and death rates;
- K2 fate against the neutral arm.
L7[L3] is Supported if, in B, conversions are no more than mutations and K2 rises through division in 3/3 seeds while the neutral arm does not. If K2 loses in B, that is the stochastic-corrector result, equally valuable. The A-vs-B contrast is your law.

SECONDARY
1. Membrane packs:
   - damage of mature, non-dividing cells on 3 seeds, reporting the hook's damage fraction;
   - a chi=0 control (is the ring load-bearing?);
   - a histogram of division axes.
2. Local phoresis for swimdiv, with no component labels.

BORROW
- Cross-inhibition beta (if invasion persists in B) and the neutral-control design: origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r1.md (Mechanism 4), packs/ad5-evolve.
- Kinds accounting with switch counts: origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/packs/xcell-her/seed0/kinds.json.
- MUSCL face flux with bodies >=6 px against heading lock: origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/REPORT_r1.md (Mechanism 5).

leaderboard_rows.note: Forms from noise. Links adsorbed at the wall make an L ring 2.1-2.5x the core and about 0 outside (three judges' seed-11 profiles). Two judges traced divisions (to gen 3) in which both daughters carry a complete ring. 9-12 persistent splits (gen 2-3) in 3 seeds. dt/2 and 2x resolution keep the ring and gen 3. 35-41% cuts re-ring within 100-150 t against twins (2 seeds). Starvation fission with high fusion and mortality. The ring comes from a designed adsorption drift. A chi=0 control (load-bearing ring?) is pending.

The lab's first dividing swimmers. The planted cell splits 4-fold, and crescent daughters with depletion wakes divide again and again (10 and 5 divisions on judge seeds 11 and 12; segments up to 7.9 BL). Reproduces with an isotropic stencil. Propulsion is a hand-coded nonlocal per-body rigid drift. Headings cluster on lattice diagonals in some seeds. L3 Weak (no material membrane). labkit tracks break for swimmers.

Walled droplets form from noise and divide by central starvation: 42-46 cells, 28-33 persistent splits, gen 3-4, in 3 seeds plus seed 11. dt/2 and 2x resolution match. The 'membrane' is 4phi(1-phi), a contour of phi, and L is a filled disk (wall/core about 1.1), so L3 is Weak. L4a is Weak (near-Supported): 3/3 round cells healed to their twins' area, on one seed. Close to Gray-Scott mitosis and Zwicker droplets.

A faster K2 mutant replaces K1 in 3/3 seeds plus seed 11, and divisions breed true. But the sweep is mostly contagion: 45 intact K1 cells converted without division against 8 mutations, K2 still swept with mutation off, and K1 cells had 0 deaths vs 174 for K2. L7 Weak. The parasite variant (extinction above a threshold) reads best as an infection model.

Heritable growth-rate trait: means drift toward about 0.16-0.18 from both starts (3+3 seeds) but have not converged and have overlapping bands. No neutral control, the trait is invisible in the sheets, and the population is frozen after about 12k. L7 Weak.

cross_pollination.suggestion: Audit ad5-evolve for horizontal allele transfer: count allele changes of living droplets without division or merge against mutation events, and run a mutation-off continuation. In autopoiesis phase_kinds, 45 conversions of intact cells against 8 mutations drove the apparent selection sweep (judge-scratch/autopoiesis-r1-biologist/kinds_lineage_s11.txt; origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/packs/phase_kinds/seed0/tracks.png, cells #26/#50/#59 change kind mid-life). Also ablate the ad3 amphiphile shell to test whether it is load-bearing, as the autopoiesis link ring is through the tilt term.

Add two autopoiesis operators to the genome: the autopoietic tilt (Allen-Cahn phi whose double well is tilted by a(L-theta), with L made by the cell's own catalyst) and the wall-adsorption drift chi*grad[4phi(1-phi)] (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/worlds/phase_membrane, REPORT_r1 Mechanisms 1-3). Together they give a boundary that the cell's product holds up and that re-forms after cuts. Front deposition does not provide this. Report horizontal kind conversions next to the switch counts in xcell-her.

Before attributing fl_forager_evo outcomes to drift, count kind changes of living bodies without division (parameter mixing at contact). In autopoiesis, a 'selection' sweep turned out to be horizontal transfer between touching cells (phase_kinds, biologist's seed-11 lineage).

To lift kstrail's L3 Weak (wake, not membrane), add an autopoietic phase wall: phi with its double well tilted by the body's own density or product, and mobilities gated by phi^2 (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/REPORT_r1.md, Mechanisms 1-3). phase_swimdiv shows that such walled cells can still swim and divide.

From active-droplets: within-droplet cross-inhibition beta (beta=1.5 killed 31/31 invading mutant patches; beta=1.1 allowed takeover) and the neutral-control design at the same mutation rate (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r1.md, Mechanism 4; packs/ad5-evolve, ad5n-neutral). Use them to close the horizontal channel in the confined arm.

From fisim-beyond-laplacian: kinds accounting per division (on->on+on, mixed, switches) as the template for lineage by kind (origin/claude/alife-fisim-beyond-laplacian:research/alife/threads/fisim-beyond-laplacian/packs/xcell-her/seed0/kinds.json). From chemotaxis-motility: a van Leer MUSCL face flux with bodies >=6 px against lattice-locked swimmer headings (REPORT_r1 Mechanism 5).

rubric_issues: L7: require lineage by kind showing that kinds change only at mutation or birth. A sweep produced by converting living individuals (horizontal transfer) is contagion. It counts as L5 evidence (infection), not L7. Report conversions of intact individuals per mutation event.

L3: a channel that is an algebraic function of the order parameter (4phi(1-phi), |grad phi|) is a contour by construction. The boundary contrast must appear in a dynamically independent (material) channel.

L4a: damage must target a mature, non-dividing individual, with an undamaged twin, on >=2 seeds. Repair that is automatic by construction (curvature flow) is allowed for the rung but scored under the mechanism modifier.

labkit: FACTS misreports the erased fraction when a world supplies its own damage hook (49 of 475 px reported vs ~36% erased). It should report the world's damage_frac. --damage targets the largest component, which is usually already dividing.

labkit: tracks break for moving cells (swimdiv persistent splits 1-4 vs ~10 real divisions). The rim metric uses the segmentation's outer layer and underreads real membranes (phase_membrane rim/core 0.16-0.32 vs 0.42-0.46 for the membraneless base). Judges need per-channel radial profiles.
